title: Buying apples
scene: A shopper and a seller at a fruit stall

lines.speaker: 女
lines.py: Nǐ hǎo, píngguǒ duōshao qián?
lines.en: Hello, how much are the apples?

lines.speaker: 男
lines.py: Dà píngguǒ wǔ kuài qián yí gè.
lines.en: The big apples are five kuai each.

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 太贵了！有便宜一点儿的吗？
lines.py: Tài guì le! Yǒu piányi yìdiǎnr de ma?
lines.en: That's too expensive! Do you have cheaper ones?

lines.speaker: 男
lines.py: Zhèxiē xiǎo de sān kuài qián yí gè.
lines.en: These small ones are three kuai each.

lines.speaker: 女
lines.py: Hǎo, wǒ mǎi sì gè xiǎo de.
lines.en: OK, I'll buy four small ones.

lines.speaker: 男
lines.py: Hǎo de, shí'èr kuài qián. Xièxie!
lines.en: Sure, that's twelve kuai. Thank you!

questions.promptPy: Dà píngguǒ duōshao qián yí gè?
questions.promptEn: How much is one big apple?
questions.explanation: The seller says 大苹果五块钱一个 in line 2.

questions.promptEn: How many apples did she buy?
questions.explanation: She says 我买四个小的 in line 5.

questions.promptEn: What does she think of the big apples?
questions.explanation: She says 太贵了 in line 3 after hearing the price.

title: Breakfast before school
scene: Two classmates at home in the morning

lines.speaker: 男
lines.py: Xiànzài jǐ diǎn?
lines.en: What time is it now?

lines.speaker: 女
lines.py: Xiànzài qī diǎn bàn.
lines.en: It's half past seven.

lines.speaker: 男
lines.py: Wǒmen jǐ diǎn qù xuéxiào?
lines.en: What time are we going to school?

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 八点。我们现在吃早饭吧。
lines.py: Bā diǎn. Wǒmen xiànzài chī zǎofàn ba.
lines.en: At eight. Let's have breakfast now.

lines.speaker: 男
lines.py: Hǎo, wǒ xiǎng hē niúnǎi.
lines.en: OK, I'd like some milk.

lines.speaker: 女
lines.py: Zhèlǐ yǒu miànbāo hé niúnǎi.
lines.en: There's bread and milk here.

questions.explanation: She says 现在七点半 in line 2.

questions.promptEn: What time do they go to school?
questions.explanation: She answers 八点 in line 4.

questions.promptEn: What does the man want to drink?
questions.explanation: He says 我想喝牛奶 in line 5.

title: My family
scene: A student talks about his family

lines.speaker: 男
lines.py: Wǒ jiā yǒu wǔ kǒu rén.
lines.en: There are five people in my family.

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 爸爸、妈妈、哥哥、妹妹和我。
lines.py: Bàba, māma, gēge, mèimei hé wǒ.
lines.en: Dad, Mom, my older brother, my younger sister and me.

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 爸爸是医生，在医院工作。
lines.py: Bàba shì yīshēng, zài yīyuàn gōngzuò.
lines.en: My dad is a doctor and works at a hospital.

lines.speaker: 男
lines.py: Māma shì lǎoshī.
lines.en: My mom is a teacher.

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 哥哥是大学生，今年二十岁。
lines.py: Gēge shì dàxuéshēng, jīnnián èrshí suì.
lines.en: My brother is a university student. He is twenty this year.

lines.speaker: 男
lines.py: Wǒ jiā hái yǒu yì zhī māo.
lines.en: We also have a cat.

questions.promptPy: Tā jiā yǒu jǐ kǒu rén?
questions.promptEn: How many people are in his family?
questions.explanation: Line 1 says 我家有五口人.
Line 3 says his dad 在医院工作. The teacher is his mom.

questions.promptEn: How old is his brother this year?

title: A rainy day
scene: Two friends talk on the phone

lines.speaker: 女
lines.py: Wéi, nǐ zài nǎr?
lines.en: Hello, where are you?

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 我在家。今天下雨，我不想去外边。
lines.py: Wǒ zài jiā. Jīntiān xià yǔ, wǒ bù xiǎng qù wàibian.
lines.en: I'm at home. It's raining today, so I don't want to go out.

lines.speaker: 女
lines.py: Míngtiān tiānqì zěnmeyàng?
lines.en: What will the weather be like tomorrow?

lines.speaker: 男
lines.py: Míngtiān méiyǒu yǔ, hěn rè.
lines.en: It won't rain tomorrow. It'll be hot.

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 那我们明天去看电影吧。
lines.py: Nà wǒmen míngtiān qù kàn diànyǐng ba.
lines.en: Then let's go and see a movie tomorrow.

lines.speaker: 男
lines.py: Hǎo, míngtiān jiàn!
lines.en: OK, see you tomorrow!

questions.explanation: He says 我在家 in line 2.

questions.promptEn: What will the weather be like tomorrow?
questions.explanation: Line 4 says 明天没有雨，很热. The rain is today.
She suggests 明天去看电影 in line 5 and he agrees.

title: Ordering dumplings
scene: A customer orders at a small restaurant

lines.speaker: 男
lines.py: Nǐ hǎo, qǐngwèn nǐ xiǎng chī shénme?
lines.en: Hello, what would you like to eat?

lines.speaker: 女
lines.py: Wǒ xiǎng chī jiǎozi. Yǒu bāozi ma?
lines.en: I'd like dumplings. Do you have steamed buns?

lines.speaker: 男
lines.py: Duìbuqǐ, jīntiān méiyǒu bāozi.
lines.en: Sorry, we don't have buns today.

lines.speaker: 女
lines.py: Méi guānxi. Wǒ yào jiǎozi hé chá.
lines.en: That's fine. I'll have dumplings and tea.

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 好的，饺子二十块，茶五块。
lines.py: Hǎo de, jiǎozi èrshí kuài, chá wǔ kuài.
lines.en: Sure. The dumplings are twenty kuai and the tea is five.

questions.explanation: The waiter says 今天没有包子 in line 3.

questions.promptEn: What does the woman want to drink?
questions.explanation: She orders 饺子和茶 in line 4.
Line 5 says 饺子二十块. Five kuai is the tea.

title: A student's day
scene: A middle school student describes her week

lines.speaker: 女
lines.py: Wǒ shì zhōngxuéshēng.
lines.en: I'm a middle school student.

lines.speaker: 女
lines.py: Wǒ zǎoshang liù diǎn qǐchuáng.
lines.en: I get up at six in the morning.

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 上午和下午在学校上课。
lines.py: Shàngwǔ hé xiàwǔ zài xuéxiào shàngkè.
lines.en: In the morning and afternoon I have classes at school.

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 星期六我不上学，我和同学去书店看书。
lines.py: Xīngqīliù wǒ bú shàngxué, wǒ hé tóngxué qù shūdiàn kàn shū.
lines.en: On Saturday I don't go to school. I go to the bookstore with classmates to read.

lines.speaker: 女
lines.py: Wǎnshang shí diǎn wǒ shuìjiào.
lines.en: I go to bed at ten at night.

questions.promptEn: What time does she get up?
questions.explanation: Line 2 says 我早上六点起床.

questions.promptEn: Where does she go on Saturday?
questions.explanation: Line 4 says she doesn't go to school on Saturday and goes 去书店.

questions.promptEn: What time does she go to bed?
questions.explanation: Line 5 says 晚上十点我睡觉.
